english.title: A small counting experiment
english.intro: A walking robot leaves one marker at its first stop, two markers at its next stop, and one more at each later stop. We want a quick way to count the markers without drawing every stop.
english.definition: Let ⟦F:demo-n⟧ be the number of stops, and let ⟦F:demo-s⟧ be the total marker count. The following rule gives the answer.
english.reason: Read the product before dividing: pair the first short row with a reversed copy of the last long row. Every pair has the same length, so the rearranged picture forms a rectangle. Each original picture occupies half of that rectangle.
english.code-title: Check the idea with a loop
english.caption: Listing 1. A direct count used to check the rule.
english.conclusion: The formula and the loop count the same arrangement in different ways. The formula avoids visiting every stop; the loop makes the counting process easy to inspect.
english.exercise: Try it: use four stops, and explain why two copies of the pattern always make a rectangle.
english.note: This page was written from scratch for a layout demonstration.

chinese.title: 一个计数小实验
chinese.intro: 一个行走机器人在首次停靠时留下一个标记，在下一次停靠时留下两个标记，此后每次都比上次多留一个。我们希望找到一种快速计数的方法，不必把每次停靠都画出来。
chinese.definition: 用 ⟦F:demo-n⟧ 表示停靠次数，用 ⟦F:demo-s⟧ 表示标记总数。下面的规则给出答案。
chinese.reason: 先看乘积，再做除法：把最短的一行与另一份反向排列图案中最长的一行配对。每一对都一样长，因此重新组合后形成矩形。每份原图恰好占这个矩形的一半。
chinese.caption: 代码1：通过直接计数检验规则。
chinese.conclusion: 公式和循环用不同的方法计算同一个排列中的标记数。公式无需逐次访问所有停靠点；循环则让计数过程便于检查。
chinese.exercise: 试一试：采用四次停靠，解释为什么两份图案总能拼成一个矩形。
chinese.note: 本页为排版演示全新编写，未摘录教材。
